name: SkillCraft1 StarCraft II replay actions per minute
source_citation: Blair, M., Thompson, J., Henrey, A., and Chen, B. (2013). SkillCraft1 Master Table Dataset. UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C5161N. Study: https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0075129
preparation: Read the numeric APM from each eligible replay and retain four background fields. Drop 57 incomplete profiles and one record whose reported playtime exceeds the player's lifetime. No same-replay action counts, timing statistics or game identifiers enter the prompt.
split_guidance: Keep matching four-field profiles in one group. Sort released group IDs, then allocate 70%, 15% and 15% of groups to train, validation and test by largest remainder. The study collected one replay per respondent. GameID identifies a replay in the public table.
quality_findings: All 55 Professional-league rows lack age and playtime information. The released cohort spans Bronze through GrandMaster.
Playtime is self-reported. Different replays can have the same profile and different APM.

actions_per_minute.instruction: Estimate the player's average number of actions per minute in this StarCraft II replay.
actions_per_minute.field_description: league_index is the ranked league: 1 Bronze, 2 Silver, 3 Gold, 4 Platinum, 5 Diamond, 6 Master, 7 GrandMaster, 8 Professional. age_years is the player's age in years. hours_played_per_week and total_hours_played are self-reported weekly and lifetime StarCraft II playtime, both in hours.

source_version: UCI dataset 272, donated 2013-10-21, pinned static ZIP

stats.name: SkillCraft1 StarCraft II replay actions per minute

deduplication_rule: Same task, normalized input, normalized label AND official split; preserve all source_refs. Across-split copies retained and flagged, same-input dependencies unioned. Different labels retained.
sample_id_rule: sha256([task_id,input_hash,label,split]) first 24 hex; official split included to preserve split occurrences.
